summary: Command Palette design spec (RT-38b) complete. 16-section spec covering: 560px centered modal at 20vh, search input with fuzzy filtering, result groups (Navigation/Actions/Settings/Recent/Items), 4 interaction states per item, keyboard navigation with scroll-into-view, empty/no-results states, shortcut cheat sheet modal, dark mode via --forge-* tokens, desktop-only (1024px+), 150ms open / 100ms close animations, full ARIA combobox/listbox pattern, complete CSS modules ready for Alice to copy directly. 8 key design decisions documented.
